record.name: color/state/pressed/overlay
record.description: Opaque pressed wash over a control's own fill: black in light, white in dark. Alpha in the class (inset-shadow-pressed-overlay/5).

record.name: pressed-overlay
record.description: Pressed-state overlay colour role. Apply alpha in the class, e.g. inset-shadow-pressed-overlay/5.

descriptions.VariableID:2061:875: Compact inline control target minimum, e.g. a chip's remove button: WCAG 2.2 AA (2.5.8), not the 44px AAA floor (2.5.5).
descriptions.VariableID:2061:876: Docs-shell rail width (hds#280): our own number, not HeroUI's 268px; fits the longest top-level nav label with room.
descriptions.VariableID:2061:880: 24px. Default of the overridable roles surface.padding and region.gutter. The deprecated layout.normal has the same value.
descriptions.VariableID:2061:883: 24px (scale.md) inset for cards, forms and panels. Tenants override it per brand and density. Replaces component.padding. Varies by brand and density: its value comes from Hirobius/Density.
descriptions.VariableID:2061:884: 24px (scale.md) column and region gutters; theme.css sets scale.lg (32px), and scale.sm (16px) below 640px. Replaces layout.gutter.
descriptions.VariableID:10:34: 24px inset for cards, forms and panels. DEPRECATED alias (hds#206) — use semantic.space.surface.padding; kept live, no removal yet.
descriptions.VariableID:10:39: 48px break between major content blocks. DEPRECATED alias (hds#206) — use semantic.space.scale.xl; kept live, no removal yet.
descriptions.VariableID:2061:885: Docs-shell nav and TOC rail width (hds#280), one token for both rails; 0 below their breakpoint (see HdsDocsShell).
descriptions.VariableID:2061:886: Corner radius for small control glyphs such as the checkbox box: not fully round, and distinct from semantic.radius.action (hds#242).
descriptions.VariableID:2061:893: Avatar size (width and height) for activity feeds and identity glyphs. Same pixels as row.compact today, a separate role (hds#242).
